headline: Wardwizard Healthcare appoints Diksha Sharma
summary: Wardwizard Healthcare appoints Diksha Sharma as Additional Independent Director for 5 years. She is an advocate and IICA empanelled professional.

headline: Oswal Agro fixes Nov 7 record date for interim dividend
summary: Oswal Agro Mills Ltd has fixed November 7, 2026, as the record date for its interim dividend for FY27. The board meeting to declare the dividend is scheduled for November 4, 2026.

headline: Karnataka Bank appoints Sughosh Nagendra as CTO
summary: Karnataka Bank has appointed Sughosh Nagendra as Chief Technology Officer with effect from October 30, 2026. He brings over 27 years of IT experience.

headline: REC Ltd ED J.K. Nayak resigns to join IREDA
summary: REC Limited announced the cessation of Executive Director J.K. Nayak on October 30, 2026, following his appointment as CMD of IREDA.

headline: Finolex Cables reports insider trading violation by advisor
summary: Finolex Cables disclosed a Code of Conduct violation by an advisor involving contra trades. The company recovered ₹423.75 in profits and issued a warning letter.

headline: Mangalam Global promoter Vipin Mangal to acquire 2.31% stake via gift
summary: Vipin Prakash Mangal will acquire 76 lakh shares from Rashmi Mangal, increasing his stake to 14.96%. The transfer is exempt from open offer requirements.

headline: Creative Newtech board to meet Nov 4 on fund-raising
summary: Creative Newtech Limited scheduled a board meeting for November 4, 2026, to evaluate fund-raising options and acquisitions. Trading window remains closed until results announcement.

headline: Vaswani Industries promoter acquires 1.53 lakh shares
summary: Manisha Vaswani acquired 1,53,845 equity shares via preferential allotment, raising her stake to 7.16%. Total promoter group holding increased to 63.86% of the company.

headline: Anurag Sinha exits Engineers India as ED
summary: Anurag Sinha, Executive Director (Structural) at Engineers India, ceased his role on November 1, 2026, following superannuation. The change was disclosed to BSE and NSE.

headline: Taj GVK Hotels renamed Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels
summary: Taj GVK Hotels & Resorts has changed its name to Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels Limited, with the transition taking effect on October 30, 2026. Legal status and obligations remain unchanged.

headline: Capillary Technologies gets KPMG forensic audit report
summary: Capillary Technologies India received a forensic audit report from KPMG on a cyber fraud incident. The report confirms external impersonation with no technical issues or employee involvement.

headline: Interarch Building wins ₹67.56 crore aircraft hangar order
summary: Interarch Building Solutions has won a ₹67.56 crore order for an aircraft hangar project in New Delhi, with an expected completion timeline of about 8 months.

headline: Larsen & Toubro extends Vyoma.AI deal deadline
summary: Larsen & Toubro has extended the deadline for its business deal with Vyoma.AI Limited to March 31, 2027, pushing the timeline for the transaction's completion.

headline: IDBI Bank workers plan two-day strike in November 2026
summary: IDBI Bank co-workers have announced a strike on November 2 and 3, 2026, over their demands. The industrial action signals ongoing workforce concerns at the bank.

headline: Taneja Aerospace Q2 net profit rises 77% YoY
summary: Taneja Aerospace & Aviation Ltd reported a net profit of ₹69 million in Q2, up from ₹39 million year-on-year. Revenue grew to ₹112 million from ₹97 million.

headline: Syrma SGS Q2 revenue up 73.6% to ₹19.9 billion
summary: Syrma SGS reported Q2 revenue of ₹19.9 billion, a 73.6% YoY rise from ₹11.46 billion. EBITDA stood at ₹1.93 billion, though margins contracted slightly to 9.72%.

headline: Sai Silks opens 87th store in Yelahanka, Bengaluru
summary: Sai Silks (Kalamandir) has opened its 87th store in Yelahanka, Bengaluru on October 31, 2026, expanding its retail presence under the Kalamandir format.
